notes.title: Moving Out 2 | 1.3 Patch notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42849904/23f0ebaee8310d29ef2cc22314cc123685059a05.jpg[/img]

Greetings F.A.R.T's! We've just released the 1.3 patch for Moving Out 2! 

Thank you all for your feedback and bug reporting so far. Thanks to your help, we've managed to get this update out to you now with the following fixes and improvements! Unpack the full list below 📦

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42849904/4f0bf073d80fbeb2f5ca0803c40c245c2ace4bd3.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Improved Online performance 
[*] Fixed the “Don’t get off the train” bonus objective 
[*] Fixed an issue where items would jitter and clip through walls in “Sushi Gardens” 
[*] Fixed an issue in “Recall Road” where the battery can clip behind a wall 
[*] Fixed multiple connection issues when controllers are disconnected at certain times 
[*] Fixed issues with Brazilian Portuguese subtitles not appearing in certain areas 
[*] Fixed an issue which would cause the Team17 overlay to crash or not respond when the player has a high number of friends on their system 
[*] Fixed a crash when returning to the menu after failing a level 
[*] Fixed an issue where suspending your user would cause a crash when online 
[*] Fixed an issue where the “Don’t use the sliding door” objective would unlock without actually completing the objective 
[*] Fixed an issue where certain arcade levels wouldn’t show as unlocked until the game was restarted 
[*] Fixed an issue where crystals on “Train to Train Drive” could get stuck 
[*] Fixed multiple issues regarding key rebindings 
[*] Fixed an issue on “Scorching Scurry” where items could launch into the air and become stuck 
[*] Fixed an issue where certain achievements didn’t unlock when expected 
[*] Fixed an issue where music wouldn’t play in all areas as expected 
[*] Fixed an issue with the pistons in “Battery Leap Frog” when playing in reduced difficult mode 
[/list]

Thank you once again for all your help reporting these issues and we hope you have a Smooth time helping the residents of Packmore and beyond in the 1.3 version. If you find any more issues, please raise them in the support section of the Discord server or on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1641700/discussions/1/][u]Report a Problem section on the Steam Forums[/u][/url].

notes.title: Update 1.3 coming soon & important multiplayer information
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42849904/cc38dd00b82ed5e90c69f69e345718c1fe776260.png[/img]
Today we are here to announce that the [b]1.3 patch[/b] is coming imminently to resolve some pesky issues that have been found and raised by the community since launch (A big thank you to everyone who has helped report and log the issues they have found).

As part of the 1.3 update, we should see improvements across the board of the game when playing online and locally, [b]however part of this will require that you will have to recreate your "Team17 Account" within Moving Out 2.[/b] 

This is simple to do by following the simple prompts when you start the game after the update. A side effect of this however is that you will unfortunately lose any friends that you have made up to now on the old profile, so you will have to reconnect with the people you play with once again. While this isn't ideal, we can expect it to be beneficial in the long run for your enjoyment of the game running on the new 1.3 update with all the fixes it brings.

We also recommend that you make a note of the players you have already on your Team17 Friends list so you know who to re-add once the update launches and they also recreate their new accounts. 

[b]If you are looking for a place to find new people to play with, we recommend you join the Moving Out 2 Discord server, where we have a Looking For Game channel which you can use to find fellow F.A.R.T's to play with!
[/b]
[url=https://discord.gg/qwD6HBMhru][u][b]Click this link to get on board the Smooth Moves Van on its destination to our official Discord server![/b][/u][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34085797/3cdb10ed146028163e872a5d71fdcf4f75dcfb61.png[/img]

notes.title: Moving Out 2 is Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/mTKw9uT.gif[/img]

[h2]THE VAN’S PACKED, THE SINK’S...SOMEWHERE, AND IT’S TIME TO GO, MOVING OUT 2 LAUNCHES TODAY!
[/h2]

SMG Studio, DevM Games, and Team17 Digital have today launched couch moving co-op game Moving Out 2!

Featuring online crossplay multiplayer, Moving Out 2 sees the Furniture Arrangement and Relocation Technicians (F.A.R.Ts) head beyond the realms of their dimension and go multiversal, tackling futuristic furniture, fantastical finery, and frantic farm animals as they keep their cool, lift with their spine, and transport almost everything in one piece. 

[b]Everything’s packed except this brand-new launch trailer:[/b]

[previewyoutube=lquKsZmuEZU;full][/previewyoutube]

[u][b]Moving Out 2 Key Features
[/b][/u][list]
[*] Location, location, location: Travel the multiverse and overcome new levels and puzzles that pit F.A.R.Ts with their biggest removals challenge yet.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/64tj8sJ.gif[/img]

[*] Co-op Continued: Players can either take on Moving Out 2 solo or with friends (or enemies) in both couch and cross-play enabled online co-op.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42849904/13cdcdf8d1fdfa953f6ac7b451e2b9352e816c50.gif[/img]

[*] Assist mode: Movers of all abilities are welcome in Packmore; with Assist Mode, the possibilities (and fun) are endless, and inclusive!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/khRrs43.gif[/img]

[*] Zany characters: Featuring a whole new host of smooth movers, Moving Out 2 showcases entirely new characters that will both enchant and horrify.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/OMnXmp2.gif[/img]
[/list]
So there we go! You know what to do! Sign up to join Smooth Moves and become the ultimate F.A.R.T you can be, either solo or with your friends and family and help the residents of Packmore and beyond by putting on a moving masterclass and purchase Moving Out 2 today!

notes.title: Moving Out 2 | Pre Orders Now Live
notes.content:
You've seen that we've scheduled our moving date and you've chosen your favourite F.A.R.T, so probably think you are now all set to Move Out now? WRONG! We've one last thing for your checklist...

[h2]PRE-ORDERING MOVING OUT 2![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42849904/c5dec40175fdb159950ef1c9a987e5cd7a949a29.jpg[/img]
Moving Out 2 is now available to Pre-Order so you can finally get ready for our August 15th launch date! We've different options available for pre-order available so you can get the right version for you!

[b]Here we are going to unpack what comes in each version available to pre-order
[/b]
[h2]Standard edition[/h2]
Moving Out 2 base game.
 
[h2]Moving Out 1+2 bundle[/h2]
The ultimate Moving Out experience - a copy of both Moving Out 1 & 2 base games in one neat bundle! (This will become available on launch - August 15th)

[h2]Digital Deluxe Edition (PC Exclusive)[/h2] 
There's no better way to move than with the Digital Deluxe Edition of Moving Out 2. 
Includes:[list]
[*] Moving Out 2 base game
[*] The Art & Design of Moving Out 2: A 250+ page digital art book
[*] Jumbo Super Silly Activity Book: A digital kids activity book
[*] Behind the Scenes Commentary: Over 4 hrs of behind-the-scenes commentary on the making of Moving Out 2 from SMG, Brad Gentle the composer and Sub Zero the sound design team
[*] 3D Printable Models: Print your own movers
[*] Soundtrack: 24 Original Tracks composed for the game[/list]
[h2]F.A.R.Tastic Four DLC Pre-order Bonus[/h2]

Every pre-order of either the Standard or Digital Deluxe versions of the game comes with [b]The F.A.R.Tastic Four Pack[/b], a pack of 4 additional movers for Moving Out 2 absolutely free as a little thank you for your eagerness to move out!

[h2]Unpack our Pre Order Trailer now![/h2]

Once pre-ordered, you'll be ready to move into Packmore and its surrounding dimensions ready for launch day! 📦
